scope: User-requested blood ancestor and additional trait redraws

jobs.name: Feline Instincts
jobs.description: This character was born with the uncanny balance and predatory reflexes of a great feline. It is a biological legacy that manifests in every graceful movement.
jobs.prompt: Subject: (an elegant heraldic cat head:1.4), silver feline profile with alert ears and emerald eyes, dark emerald enamel backing, feline grace and predator instincts, compact medieval animal emblem. Use the supplied image as a reference for its central symbol, palette and painted finish.

jobs.name: Hound’s Devotion
jobs.description: A deep-seated instinct for loyalty and protection is hard-coded into this character's nature. They possess a natural affinity for group cohesion and unwavering persistence.
jobs.prompt: Subject: (a noble heraldic hound head:1.4), a loyal hunting hound in silver relief with floppy ears, burgundy enamel backing, guardian devotion, compact medieval animal emblem. Use the supplied image as a reference for its central symbol, palette and painted finish.

jobs.name: Lunar Lucidity
jobs.description: Born under a specific lunar resonance, this character possesses a mind of crystalline clarity. Their thoughts are as sharp and cold as starlight, unclouded by common distractions.
jobs.prompt: Subject: (a luminous silver crescent moon:1.4), a single clear sapphire droplet suspended inside the crescent, moonlit clarity and calm, restrained midnight-blue enamel. Use the supplied image as a reference for its central symbol, palette and painted finish.

jobs.name: Boar-Heart Vigor
jobs.description: A congenital predispostion for physical mass and aggressive adrenaline. This character’s body is built for the charge, possessing a thick-skinned resilience to pain.
jobs.prompt: Subject: (a powerful heraldic wild boar head:1.4), heavy silver snout with two curved ivory tusks, burgundy enamel and aged gold details, vigor and resilience. Use the supplied image as a reference for its central symbol, palette and painted finish.

jobs.name: Shadow-Veined
jobs.description: This character’s physiology is naturally adapted to the dark. Their movements are silent, and their presence seems to bleed into the shadows even in broad daylight.
jobs.prompt: Subject: (a black bat with spread wings:1.4), silver-edged bat wings enclosing a dark purple blood gem, shadow ancestry and silent movement, compact heraldic emblem. Use the supplied image as a reference for its central symbol, palette and painted finish.

jobs.name: Gale-Strider Blood
jobs.description: This character possesses an unusually lightweight frame and a metabolism built for bursts of extreme speed. They seem to move with the effortless momentum of the wind itself.
jobs.prompt: Subject: (a silver horse head with a flowing windswept mane:1.4), a few blue enamel wind curls, swiftness and inherited speed, compact heraldic emblem. Use the supplied image as a reference for its central symbol, palette and painted finish.

jobs.name: Morningstar Aura
jobs.description: There is an inborn radiance to this character that inspires hope in others. This congenital magnetism makes them a natural focal point for morale and resilience.
jobs.prompt: Subject: (a radiant eight-pointed morning star:1.4), a warm golden star surrounding a pearl-white center, restrained silver rays, innate hope and resilience. Use the supplied image as a reference for its central symbol, palette and painted finish.

jobs.name: Trickster’s Spark
jobs.description: A neurological predisposition for lateral thinking and linguistic gymnastics. This character sees the absurdity in all things, making them as unpredictable as they are clever.
jobs.prompt: Subject: (a medieval jester cap with three curled points and tiny bells:1.4), burgundy and emerald enamel panels with gold edging, clever trickster wit, compact emblem. Use the supplied image as a reference for its central symbol, palette and painted finish.

jobs.name: Carrion-Sense
jobs.description: This character possesses a heightened, almost supernatural intuition regarding mortality and change. They sense the coming of disaster with the instinct of a scavenger.
jobs.prompt: Subject: (a single black raven in profile:1.4), folded wings, alert silver eye, perched on a short weathered branch, watchful ancestral intuition, silver highlights on dark feathers. Use the supplied image as a reference for its central symbol, palette and painted finish.

jobs.name: Draconic Potency
jobs.description: The character's blood runs hot with an ancient power. They possess a natural resistance to heat and a physical presence that commands immediate, instinctive submission.
jobs.prompt: Subject: (a coiled silver dragon with a raised head:1.4), one folded wing and a deep red ruby blood gem at its chest, restrained ember accents, draconic ancestral power. Use the supplied image as a reference for its central symbol, palette and painted finish.

jobs.name: Peace of Mind
jobs.description: Your mind is free of burden. Stress remains at zero and accumulates almost never. All current stress is removed when obtained.
jobs.prompt: Subject: (a serene ivory lotus blossom:1.4), a single open lotus flower with soft jade-green leaves, restrained aged gold edging, calm mind and freedom from stress. Use the supplied image as a reference for its central symbol, palette and painted finish.

jobs.name: Maxed Attributes (Locked)
jobs.description: All core attributes and Prowess are locked at 100. No event, aging or effect can alter them.
jobs.prompt: Subject: (a heavy ornate golden padlock:1.5), a broad blank dark enamel faceplate on the padlock body, thick closed gold shackle, restrained medieval decoration, permanent mastery of all attributes, no lettering. Use the supplied image as a reference for its central symbol, palette and painted finish.

jobs.name: Poison Immunity
jobs.description: Immune to disease and plague. All existing illnesses are cured upon gaining this trait.
jobs.prompt: Subject: (a jade-green shield with a silver serpent curled around a healing staff:1.4), a compact protective medicinal emblem, immunity to poison and disease. Use the supplied image as a reference for its central symbol, palette and painted finish.

jobs.name: Plague Immunity
jobs.description: This character, blessed by 'Barbara', will not contract the plague.
jobs.prompt: Subject: (a steel shield enclosing an ivory plague-doctor mask:1.4), a small green healing leaf beneath the beaked mask, protective gold rim, immunity to plague, compact emblem. Use the supplied image as a reference for its central symbol, palette and painted finish.

jobs.name: Blood of the Dúnedain
jobs.description: This character possesses the noble blood of the Men of the West, granting them longevity and wisdom beyond their peers.
jobs.prompt: Subject: (a silver heraldic tree with a single red ruby at its roots:1.4), dark forest-green enamel and a modest silver frame, noble ranger ancestry, Blood of the Dunedain. Use the supplied image as a reference for its central symbol, palette and painted finish.

jobs.name: Blood of Númenor
jobs.description: This character is a scion of the High Númenóreans, carrying the pure lineage of Westernesse from the days of old.
jobs.prompt: Subject: (a crowned silver heraldic tree with a large red ruby at its roots:1.4), a regal gold crown and royal blue enamel within a gold frame, ancient royal lineage of Numenor. Use the supplied image as a reference for its central symbol, palette and painted finish.
